evidence.quote: HVS3, the unbound star very near the LMC, has received considerable attention.
HVS3 is a 9\mathrm { M _ { \odot } }B star (Bonanos et al. 2008; Przybilla et al. 2008b)

Edelmann et al. (2005) reported an 9\mathrm { M _ { \odot } }main sequence B star with a Galactic rest frame velocity
of at least +548 km s<sup>−1</sup>, possibly ejected from the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC).
HVS3, the unbound star very near the LMC, has received considerable attention.

values.condition: Galactic rest-frame velocity reported for the 9 Msun B star identified as HVS3; 'at least' gives a lower limit. The paper describes this as a rest-frame/line-of-sight velocity, so it is retained as a lower bound on the star's Galactic-rest-frame speed. Possibly ejected from the LMC.
